Speech.NativeText: :-) %1 is ripped! I've seen %2 with %3 shirt off. I had to sit down and catch my breath.
%1 is kind of our pack mule. If you need anything lifted up and put down somewhere else, %2 can do that for you.
I've seen %1 take down a white strain infected bare handed. }:-| I'd advise you not to tangle with %2.
}:-| We know how to defend ourselves. %1 can put a bullet between your eyes before you even raise your gun.
}:-| Start any shit around here and %1 will stick you full of arrows! %2 is an excellent shot.
}:-| There's something creepy about how %1 can sneak up behind you without making any noise. Sure it's useful for hunting but it makes me nervous.
I never met anyone who can build shit like %1 can, %2's an engineering genius!
:-( I wish I had %1 green fingers. Everything I plant dies.
The best thing about this group is %1 cooking. It's the biggest reason I'm still here! In fact... it might be the only reason I'm still here.
Ain't many people I trust in this world but I know I can always rely on %1 for medical advice. %2's the real deal.
%1 is a good person to stand behind in a fight. Nothing seems to faze %2, %3 just barrels through it.
}:-| %1 needs to get in shape. There's no room for weakness in this outfit.
:-) %1 is pretty fit isn't %2?
%1 can hold %2 own in a brawl. }:-| Probably a bad idea to cross %3.
}:-| I wouldn't say it to %1 face but %2 really isn't much use in a hand to hand fight. I can't always be saving %3 ass.
%1 is pretty okay at shooting guns. Good enough to work here!
}:-| I don't like to criticise but %1 can't shoot to save %2 life. Which %3 may have to one day.
I saw %1 shooting arrows at an infected earlier, %2 hit it quite often. Nice going.
}:-| %1 can't shoot straight with that bow and it's going to get someone killed. But nobody listens to me!
I've seen %1 hunting deer and %2 ain't bad! Could be quieter though.
}:-| %1 freaks me out crashing around making so much noise all the time.
%1 is a helpful person to have around if you need to jerry-rig some contraption or structure.
{:-| %1 can't nail two boards together without messing it up somehow, I wouldn't trust %2 with any construction projects.
%1 has a good working knowledge of horticulture in the local conditions.
}:-| %1 has many talents but botany isn't one of them. We'd starve for sure if we relied on %2 for farming... again.
:-) %1 knows a few decent recipes, and %2 can skin a rabbit.
{:-) %1 tried so hard to cook something nice for us but the results were... not good.
%1 has some rough first aid knowledge. It often comes in useful.
%1 may not have any fancy medical knowledge but %2 bandages did the job... how hard can it be anyway?
:-) %1 tells me %2's in pretty good health nowadays.
%1 hasn't been eating too well. I'm worried %2's more fragile than %3 looks.
}:-| Are you eyeing up my %1? Keep it in your pants!
:-) That's why I love %1!
